purpose: Read-only public-index association diagnostic, not accuracy evaluation or classifier change
physical_digests: Prior fresh complete bound archive reads; not producer digests

database_schema_sql.artifacts: CREATE TABLE artifacts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, group_id TEXT, artifact_id TEXT)
database_schema_sql.artifacts_idx: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX artifacts_idx ON artifacts(artifact_id, group_id)
database_schema_sql.indices: CREATE TABLE indices(artifact_id INTEGER, version TEXT, sha1 BLOB, archive_type TEXT, foreign key (artifact_id) references artifacts(id))
database_schema_sql.indices_sha1_idx: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX indices_sha1_idx ON indices(sha1)

query_plan: SEARCH a USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
query_kind: Complete SHA1 decoded into binary SQLite BLOB; no prefix/name/version fallback
limitations: DB and Trivy peer share the same identity source and are correlated, not independent evidence engines.
DB SHA1 unique index uses insert-on-conflict-do-nothing; one returned row is not global GAV uniqueness.
Public DB has no SHA256 column/API; independently computed physical SHA256 is retained separately.
SHA1 association and snapshot pin do not authenticate an artifact publisher or defeat chosen collisions.
Zero class entries remain zero: archive presence is not class/resource payload, execution, use or directness.
Uninspected/binding-UNKNOWN observations remain UNKNOWN; this lookup does not clear image/path/layer gates.
No score labels or references were read, changed, filtered, or inferred from the association results.

official_sources.claim: SQLite schema v1; SelectIndexBySha1 hex-decodes a complete SHA1 into a BLOB; unique SHA1 insertion uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; no SHA256 lookup.
An index stores GAV, SHA1 bytes and jar/aar archive type.
Official CLI has crawl/build commands; no ready exact-hash query command.
SearchBySHA1 is exact; SearchByArtifactID has group-count heuristics, excluded here.

Parser also accepts embedded POM/manifest or heuristic artifact/version results. WithChecksum can report a digest independently of identity method; shaded POMs can share enclosing JAR digest. A peer GAV plus hash does not attest its origin.
Image JAR analyzer uses the Java DB and WithChecksum; offline image mode does not mean absence of local Java DB lookups.
Public database associates Maven-index GAV and SHA1; not per-artifact publisher authentication.
